Pension under EPS-95 Scheme
*151. SHRI RIPUN BORA: Will the
Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether pensioners under
Employees' Pension Scheme (EPS-95) are
getting less than ` 2500 per month pension
inspite of present year-on-year average
inflation rate of 5.21 per cent;
(b) the total number of Employees'
Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO)
pensioners an on 30 June, 2018 thereof;
(c) total accumulated fund with interest
in EPFO account towards Employees'
Provident Fund (EPF) contributions as on
30 June, 2018 thereon;
(d) status of Koshiyari Committee
recommendations on enhancement of
pension of EPS holders; and
(e) when will the pension of EPS-95
pensioners be reviewed and what will be
minimum pension in effect thereto?
 Action against pilots found drunk
*152. SHRI  DHIRAJ PRASAD
SAHU: Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of pilots found to
be drunk before flight operation during each
of the last three years, airport-wise and
airline-wise;
(b) the action taken against them; and
(c) the action taken on being detected
Breathalyzer (BA) positive second time?

Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NA TURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that natural gas
and Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF) are being
brought under the Goods and Services Tax
(GST);

 Installation of more CEPTs in textile
industry towns
*154. DR. SASIKALA PUSHPA
RAMASWAMY: Will the Minister of
TEXTILES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has taken
steps to install more Common Effluent
Treatment Plants (CETPs) in the textile
industry towns of Coimbatore and Tirupur
to prevent further pollution of Siruvani
and Noyyal rivers;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government intended to
open more textile parks in the State of
Tamil Nadu;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether Government is facing
opposition on the ground that opening up
of more textile parks in the State would
further aggravate the pollution of river
stretches; and
(f) if so, the details thereof and
Government's response thereto?
 Task Force on reducing import
dependence
*155. DR. BANDA PRAKASH: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has set up a
high level Task Force to identify various
items and policy interventions to reduce
dependence on imports and to suggest
ways to cut import of those items which
can be manufactured or explored in the
country; and
(b) if so, the details thereof along with
India's imports during the last three years,
item-wise?
 Second phase of UDAN Scheme
*156. SHRIMA TI   VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has planned
for the second phase of Ude Desh Ka Aam
Nagrik (UDAN) Scheme across the
country;
(b) if so, the details thereof along with
the number of routes likely to be awarded
under this Scheme and the number of
airports to be connected/developed under
the same, State/UT-wise including
Himachal Pradesh;
(c) whether Government proposes to
include helicopter operators under this
scheme, if so, the details thereof; and
(d) whether Government is strongly
emphasizing on enhancing connectivity to
remote and hilly areas under this scheme,
if so, the details thereof?
 Unsettled boundary pillars along
Indo-Myanmar border
*157. SHRI K. BHABANANDA
SINGH: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether there are many unsettled
boundary pillars along Indo-Myanmar
border, if so, the details thereof; and
(b) the efforts made by surveying
agencies of the two countries to put an
end to the border demarcation issue?

 Reservation to women in police
force
†*158. SHRI PRABHAT JHA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Central Government had
advised States and Union Territories for
providing reservation to women in direct
recruitment in police force against non-
gazetted posts right from the post of
constable to the post of sub-inspector in
all the States and Union Territories;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether States have made any
provision for providing reservation to
women in direct recruitment against non-
gazetted posts in police force right from
the post of constable to sub-inspector as
per the advice of the Central Government;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

Challenges facing India's aviation
sector
1601. SHRI RIPUN BORA: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that inspite of
fastest growing aviation market, India is
facing inadequate infrastructure planning,
shortage of skills and weak regulatory
oversight;
(b) if so, whether Government is
looking to open more than 100 airports
including 70 per cent locations which have
no airfields therefor;
(c) whether Government has received
any report from CAPA-Centre for
Aviation on the Air Traffic Control (ATC)
personnel, pilots, good engineers and
projections analysis of policy and
regulatory oversight therein; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Expansion and Development of
airports under RCS
1602. SHRI DHARMAPURI
SRINIVAS: Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has
completed the identification of small towns
for expansion and development of airports
under Ude Desh Ka Aam Nagrik (UDAN)
Regional Connectivity Scheme (RCS), the
details thereof;
(b) the details of the States which have
joined hands in this scheme, and the details
of the towns and airports developed/to be
developed under this scheme, particularly
in the State of Telangana;
(c) the quantum of funds earmarked and
released so far; and
(d) the present status of the scheme?
Government's exit from Air India
1603. SHRI K. R. ARJUNAN: Will the
Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Air India is
losing close to ` 15 crore per day;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
Government is considering to exit from the
airline altogether, instead of holding 24 per
cent stake;
(c) whether it is also a fact that there

376
would not have been over 160 queries after
the preliminary information memorandum
if there were no buyers for the airline;
(d) whether it is also a fact that the
potential buyers were not comfortable
entering into a partnership with
Government and were apprehensive of
interference; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Development and upgradation of
Dumna airport, Jabalpur
1604. SHRI VIVEK K. TANKHA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION
be pleased to refer to answer to Starred
Question 72 given in the Rajya Sabha on
22 November, 2016 and state:
(a) whether Government had allocated
` 384 crore funds for the development and
upgradation of Dumna airport, Jabalpur;
(b) how much work has been done so
far in respect of building, tarmac, airstrip
and terminal building of the airport thereof;
(c) whether Government has any time
line to complete the development and
upgradation operations of Dumna airport;
and
(d) the funds utilised so far and its
details thereof?
Works undertaken at Calicut airport
1605. SHRI BINOY VISWAM: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of international flights
operated from Calicut international airport
and their destinations thereof;
(b) whether there is any proposal to
change its category/level;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether Government is aware of
the improvement works undertaken
recently in the airport; and
(e) the details of the works and the
amount spent thereon?
Privatisation of Pawan Hans Limited
†1606. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether after Air India the
Government's move on privatisation of
Pawan Hans Limited has also suffered a
setback;
(b) whether private companies are not
taking interest in the privatisation of
Pawan Hans;
(c) whether Government is planning
for 100 per cent privatisation of Pawan
Hans now; and
(d) whether privatisation of Pawan
Hans would also affect the operation of
ONGC?
Making airports in Maharashtra solar
powered
1607. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
make the airports in Maharashtra and other
parts of the country solar powered
airports on the lines of Kochi airport; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
